front.zh: 現代俳句 & 變奏   系列《13 》

zh: 負載那麽多顏色和構圖
隱藏那麼多疑義和解讀
en: Carrying so many colors and compositions
Hiding so many doubts and interpretations
Modern painting, how does it converse?
Three hundred and sixty-five miles of road
Spring, summer, autumn, winter
Passed idly by?

points.zh:
《 三百六十五里路 》
作詞 : 小軒   作曲 : 譚健常
三百六十五里路呀
越過春夏秋冬
三百六十五里路呀
豈能讓它虛度
那年萬丈的雄心
從來沒有消失過
三百六十五里路呀
從故鄉到異鄉
三百六十五里路呀

en: Fine snow
Distant mountains, empty and vast
Waiting quietly for the late-rising moon
There is always an autumn day
The wild geese fly south, tracing out
The grain lines of the years

zh: 空空  空空  空空  -----
en: Empty, empty. Empty, empty. Empty, empty-----
Wooden fish drum, chanting sutras on and off
Can it be empty?
A small path where blossoms fall among the mountains
Following a strain of song, searching
The setting sun on the long river, deep among the clouds

points.zh:
松下問童子，言師採藥去。
只在此山中，雲深不知處。
--唐。賈島《尋隱者不遇》
points.en:
Beneath the pines I asked the boy;
he said, his master had gone to gather herbs.
He is only somewhere on this mountain,
but the clouds are deep, and I know not where.
-- Tang dynasty. Jia Dao, 'Seeking the Hermit but Not Finding Him'

en: Lantern flowers
Swaying adrift in the wind
Rubbing an impression of cursive calligraphy
On the wasteland of the years
Wandering, lingering
Watching how the mortal world settles
Deep within red walls of flowers and trees
Old road, slanting sun, half-hidden
The word 'spring,' mottled and bright
Having once seen the vast sea, all other waters seem lacking
A place to set foot
Might just be the final home

points.zh:
曾經滄海難為水，
除却巫山不是雲。
取次花叢懶回顧，
半緣修道半緣君。
--唐。元稹《 離思〈其四〉》
points.en:
Having once seen the vast ocean, other waters seem hardly worth the name;
having once seen the clouds of Mount Wu, other clouds seem nothing at all.
Even passing through beds of flowers, I no longer care to look back —
half because of my cultivation of the Way, half because of you.
-- Tang dynasty. Yuan Zhen, 'Thoughts of Parting (No. 4)'
